summary: Comprehensive Architecture & Component Refinement Plan for evolving Zylvex Technologies into a unified corporate intelligence and operations command platform. Incorporates the Floot Sales Dashboard capabilities (business intelligence, revenue projections, pipeline, lead management) with the AI Studio operational architecture (Phase 0-2 governance, read-only security enforcement, OAuth scope matrix, corporate identity verification, and founder decision controls). Establishes the 10-section persistent navigation architecture, portfolio switcher, rigorous 4-tier evidence layer, and immediate correction of all unratified assumptions.
